reviews.text:
The veterinarians and reception staff are all incredibly kind and listen attentively to what I have to say!

They clearly tell me when tests aren't necessary, which is reassuring, and I trust them because they don't push unnecessary tests or anything like that.

Thank you so much for everything.

My dog ​​suddenly became unable to walk, and since it was during the Obon holiday, our regular vet was closed. I was in a difficult situation, but luckily this hospital was open and I was able to make an appointment via LINE. They examined him immediately and suspected a herniated disc, possibly requiring emergency surgery. They wrote a referral letter to another hospital, and the surgery was performed the very next day. Three days after the surgery, he was able to walk again.

The doctor's and reception staff's service was excellent, and I am filled with gratitude.

Although I had a regular vet, I wanted to continue using this hospital's services in the future, and when I inquired, they readily agreed. Thank you so much.

Mr./Ms. Kazunari Miyamoto
Thank you for your feedback.

We raise large herding dogs weighing over 35kg, but nowadays small dogs are the mainstream. While veterinarians are likely medically knowledgeable, many don't seem to know much about the characteristics of large dogs. There are many significant differences between large and small dogs. Having raised large dogs for many years, I understand this well, but the head veterinarian was very knowledgeable about large dogs. He said things that only a professional breeder would know, which surprised and reassured me a little.

My dog ​​is healthy and we don't go very often, only for vaccinations and heartworm tests, but I especially recommend this hospital to anyone raising large dogs.

The reception staff are also very professional.

My dog ​​has been receiving treatment here since he was one year old.

All the doctors are very kind, and they explain things in detail, so I have a lot of trust in them.

The clinic is clean, the reception staff are cheerful and friendly, it's easy to make an appointment, and the waiting time is short. They once had a heartfelt, handwritten animal newspaper, which was really funny and cute, and it warmed my heart to see the staff's thoughtfulness. I can't imagine going to any other hospital. The fees are also reasonable, which is reassuring.

We received excellent care for our elderly cat, who was unwell, right up until her passing.

They fully understood our wish to avoid aggressive treatment and instead provide care to ensure she didn't suffer until the very end. They always treated her with care and kindness, which made us feel at ease during our visits.

We are truly grateful, and if the opportunity arises again, we would like to continue taking our cats there from their initial vaccinations onwards.

They are open on weekends, and you can book appointments via LINE. They also contact you regarding appointment timings (if there are any delays), making visits very convenient.

My dog ​​is now 14 years old.

He has a gallbladder mucocele, and we were going to a different hospital, but I didn't trust the doctor there, so we switched to this hospital and have been coming here several times.

I'm always anxious and end up asking the same questions every time, but they always answer me very kindly.

Usually, the director's brother would see him, but this time he was on leave, so the director saw him, and he was just as gentle and kind as his brother.

He happened to have a seizure, and the director saw him then, so I've continued to ask for his help, but both doctors are so wonderful that it's hard to choose between them. If anyone is struggling to decide which hospital to go to, I really think you should switch to this one.

All the receptionists and nurses have perfect smiles, and I'm so glad we switched here. I want to be here for my dog's final moments.

I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to this hospital for everything.

This is my first time raising a dog (a toy poodle), and suddenly he started lifting his right hind leg. I immediately took him to a veterinary hospital near my home, but they told me to just monitor the condition. He didn't get any better, so I took him to this hospital.
They performed surgery right away, and now he's able to walk on all fours.
I was very worried that he would spend his whole life with one leg raised... But this doctor is very trustworthy.
I look forward to working with you in the future!
It was my first visit, and I was very pleased with the service.

I requested surgery for my one-year-old Chihuahua's patellar luxation.

She was diagnosed with patellar luxation, a condition where the kneecap dislocates. Initially, I received medication and rest at another hospital, but she wasn't getting better, and I was very worried.

When I visited this clinic, the doctor explained everything very carefully, including the risks and costs of the surgery, so I decided to go ahead with it.

It's been several months since the surgery, and now she's walking and running around energetically again, just like before. I'm so glad we had the surgery.

The staff were all very kind, and my dog ​​is no longer afraid of going to the hospital.

Thank you very much. I look forward to your continued support.

Dear Yumi Katakami,
Thank you for your feedback.
We apologize that there were aspects that did not meet your expectations.
We will continue to strive to ensure that everyone can use our services with peace of mind.

My dog ​​is elderly and has heart disease, and salons have sometimes refused to take him, but here, as the hospital is attached, they do a health check before trimming. They also offer safe and quick cuts that take breaks depending on his condition, so it's very reassuring. The cut is neat and he doesn't seem tired, which is really helpful. I would like to continue using this hospital-attached salon.

I went because my regular hospital was closed, but I wouldn't recommend going if you're a new patient.
I really got the impression that they didn't accept patients.
I felt that they were only talking about other things and ignored what I had gone to the hospital for, which was unpleasant.

I didn't ask them to test anything I'd already been examined for.
I went for something different, but they touched my stomach and told me about the above incident, and said they could give me the medicine if they knew the name, but I didn't ask for that.

We treated five cats for cat flu.
One cat in particular became seriously ill, and I believe the doctors' treatment saved it.
We are so grateful for your wonderful service that 5 stars is not enough.
Thank you so much.

Originally, we had a regular doctor nearby,
but after symptoms that seemed like cat flu were repeatedly diagnosed as allergies, we came here for a second opinion.
I looked into various hospitals, but the fact that this hospital has such high reviews and the replies to those with low reviews made me feel sincere was a big deciding factor.

In fact, the doctor who treated us was accurate, his explanations were easy to understand, and he always spoke in a gentle tone, which helped to ease my anxiety as an owner.

However, I thought that treating cat flu would be the same no matter which hospital, so for a while I continued to go to the original nearby hospital.
In the end, my cat's condition worsened to the point where hospitalization was necessary, and I was concerned about the treatment process, so I ultimately had him hospitalized here.

- Worsening pneumonia
- Difficulty breathing due to nasal congestion
- Stomach distension due to swallowing air
- Worsening liver values ​​due to malnutrition
- Decreased white blood cell count

The cat's condition was unusually severe for a 6-year-old kitten with a cat flu.
However, they immediately began providing nutrition through a nasal catheter, and thanks to their efforts, 11 days later, all of his symptoms had improved significantly and he was able to be discharged.

From his sudden admission to discharge, we must have caused more stress than we, the owners, would have expected.
However, the doctors and reception staff always treated him warmly and with kindness, without a single frown, even though he came to visit every day, and we were truly grateful for that.

They allowed us to see him on our way out on the day of his hospitalization,
they extended visiting hours because they were free that day,
they even called us about small things,
and the hospitality they showed us was endless.
I was truly lucky to have found doctors I could trust for their treatment.

We came to this clinic through word of mouth, so we're leaving this review in the hope that it will reach other pet owners looking for a reliable doctor.

I got a dog last month and after searching through various veterinary clinics, I decided on this one.
I've been taking care of my dog ​​without any problems.
Even when I take him for grooming, they listen to his heartbeat.
I feel completely at ease leaving him in their care (#^^#)
Apparently, you can also enter a contest for their calendar. That's great, he's my most beloved pet right now!

First of all, I'm a little late in expressing my gratitude, but thank you for taking such good care of our black cat. Our cat, who is about a year old, showed signs of eating the string attached to a toy, so we took him to the doctor.
The doctor was very calm and clear, and explained the various risks and the current situation to us.
He considered the burden on the cat and came up with the best course of action, and our cat was able to return home safely.
Just as the doctor predicted, the string fell apart, and the remaining string that he couldn't remove was neatly wrapped up in his feces three days later.
I was feeling down about not realizing that my cat had been in the same room as me, so I think it was a good thing that I realized he had eaten it. I think you were very lucky. Your words made me feel better.
We've reorganized our house to make sure this never happens again, and he's now doing well.
All thanks to the doctor.
Thank you so much.
Thank you for your feedback, tan-tan.

Dear Kan S,
Thank you for your feedback.

I received your care when my previous dog became weak. He was elderly and it was the first time I had been to this hospital, so I was very nervous, but you listened to me kindly and, thanks to you, we were able to say goodbye to him at home as a family.
We recently welcomed our new dog, Runrun-chan, and have decided to have her looked after here from the start. I'm looking forward to it as you also offer puppy training classes!!
We look forward to continuing to work with you in the future.

They don't offer surgery. Even though my condition truly required urgent care, they could only perform tests. Furthermore, they kept telling me they didn't know what was going on, and I was at a conference where I could be accused of being a human being. When I went for a second opinion elsewhere, I was given a completely different diagnosis than the one given here, and it almost cost me my life. I'll never go there again.

PS:
It was too late for my cat.

The doctor here lacks knowledge and experience.

Even as a research assistant conducting non-clinical trials, I could have determined by palpation that it was a pathological abnormality caused by secretory mast cells...

I just listened quietly because he had a doctor's pass...

Even though they couldn't diagnose the pancreatic pathology by palpation and performed an ultrasound, they still said it was liver-liver, which is enough to be accused of being a human being.

They also didn't have a technician to aspirate the peritoneum. The technique for aspirating a small amount of peritoneum (they didn't even consider a cannula) made it impossible to make a pathological diagnosis based on the peritoneal fluid.

This case really makes me think that we need a law to raise the level of doctors based on the Animal Welfare Act.

Before worrying about continuing the cat's treatment...

And to reduce the financial and emotional unhappiness of the owner,
if a diagnosis cannot be made, the patient should be immediately referred to another hospital.

In the case of humans,
community medical care can determine the illness,
but the doctor consults with a CRC and
referes to a specialist so they can focus on treatment.

I'm also scared of the spread of second-hand opioids in humans.

Just like humans, people suffer from illnesses,
if there was a system in place to cover those illnesses with insurance,
treatment would go much more smoothly.

This case really taught me a lot of unpleasant lessons.

My pet was in critical condition when I brought him to the emergency room at night, so I asked if he could continue hospital treatment here as he seemed to have good equipment.
Even just looking at the medical records I received from the emergency room, they said there was little chance of recovery.
They also explained the advantages and disadvantages of leaving him here versus bringing him home.
When I couldn't decide, they said, "Let's do another examination to see if he's improving," so I decided to make a decision after seeing the results.
I've seen in other reviews that some people have the impression that this clinic is very stingy, and I can understand why.
However, I was glad that I was able to make a decision after seeing the diagnosis.
(They only told me the blood test results, and I only realized they had taken an X-ray when I saw the bill.)
Ultimately, he passed away the morning after I brought him home.
Even though it was my first visit, I am grateful that they clearly and honestly conveyed the difficult situation.
Some people might find it cold, but I think it's a doctor's responsibility.
Thanks to them, I was able to let him spend his final moments in the comfort of my own home.
Thank you so much.

Last year, my beloved dog (a 1.5-year-old Chihuahua) was unwell and I took him to the hospital for an examination.

Even though I was the last patient of the evening, the head veterinarian and the staff decided to perform emergency surgery without any hesitation.

After the surgery, he recovered very well and now his appetite has increased, and he's even more energetic than before.

I still shudder to think what would have happened if he hadn't had the surgery.

I am truly grateful for the coordination and consideration shown by everyone at Joto Tsurumi Animal Hospital during his hospitalization and outpatient visits.

Thank you very much.
My beloved dog fell seriously ill, and I was referred to a large hospital by this clinic. …
The doctors and nurses take the time to talk to me, which makes me feel at ease. …
I participated in a cat adoption event. Although I didn't find a good match this time, everyone was kind and taught me a lot about how to care for and adopt a cat. I would like to participate again.

This was my first visit to a veterinary clinic since adopting a rescue dog. She's a retired breeding dog with mammary gland tumors, and I had many worries. Because she's already elderly, I was concerned about various health issues and …

The doctor has a loud voice, so I was a bit worried about my timid cat, but he was very sympathetic and listened to what I had to say. Being able to make an appointment via LINE was also great because it shortened the wait time. …

The vet is kind.

They're also good at grooming.

Dear Yu-chan,
Thank you for your feedback.
The doctor and reception staff are all very kind, which is great. Being able to book appointments via LINE is also convenient.
